_why: One table, three readers. normalisePhone lives in nala-shared.js for the page and again in worker/send-invites.js and worker/guest-contact.js for the sends, because a Worker cannot import from the site. Two copies of one rule is the thing that goes stale, so inv_suite.py, invites-test.mjs and contact-test.mjs all assert against THIS file rather than against their own idea of the rule. A case added here fails whichever copy has not learned it.
